# LoopBreaker

> LoopBreaker is a prompt pack that helps AI coding assistants detect repeated questions, actions, claims, and false progress without new evidence.
>
> LoopBreaker 是一组提示词，帮助 AI 编程助手识别反复出现却没有新证据的问题、动作、结论和假进展。

## Core

- [Core LoopBreaker protocol (English)](prompts/core/loopbreaker.md): Always-on loop detection and interruption protocol.
- [LoopBreaker 核心协议（中文）](prompts/core/loopbreaker.zh.md)：常驻的循环识别与打断协议。
- [Task kickoff prompt (English)](prompts/adapters/kickoff.md): Establish goal, constraints, acceptance criteria, and state anchor.
- [任务启动词（中文）](prompts/adapters/kickoff.zh.md)：建立目标、约束、验收条件和状态锚点。
- [Machine-readable manifest](prompts/manifest.json): Bilingual prompt index.
